title: Some battles aren’t fought in public.
paragraphs:
Some battles aren’t fought in public.
They’re fought in the heart.
And tonight… I’m asking God to win this one for me.

Prayer:
Father, I don’t want temporary change.
I want transformation.
Scrub my heart of what’s toxic.
Silence the voices that pull me away from You.
Restore the joy I once had.
Give me a spirit that is right, pure, and aligned with Your will.
Start over in me.
